input: Plan a sunrise hike for my partner's birthday

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether this is just the hike itself or includes surrounding elements (breakfast, gifts, other surprises) changes how much needs to be planned and coordinated.
The location and terrain type (coastal, mountain, forest trail) determines which specific trail to choose and how to time the sunrise arrival.
The birthday date sets the exact sunrise time and weather season, which directly affects trail selection, gear needed, and how early they must leave.
Whether it is just the two of them or a group changes logistics, secrecy coordination, transport, and the overall atmosphere of the experience.
The partner's fitness level and hiking experience determines trail difficulty — a gruelling climb vs. a gentle scenic walk are very different plans.
Understanding what would make this feel special to the partner (romance, adventure, a peaceful moment, a celebratory element) focuses the planning on what actually matters.
Knowing if the user wants a full step-by-step plan, a checklist, or just trail recommendations shapes the format and depth of the output.

gold.taskTitle: Plan a sunrise hike for partner's birthday
gold.taskDescription: Organise a memorable sunrise hike as a birthday experience for the user's partner.

questions.title: Which city or region are you hiking in?
questions.description: Identifies the geographic location to narrow down specific trails and accurate sunrise timing.

questions.title: What date is your partner's birthday?
questions.description: The exact date determines the sunrise time, season, expected weather, and how far in advance to prepare.

questions.title: How experienced a hiker is your partner?
questions.description: Establishes fitness level and trail difficulty — from easy scenic walks to strenuous summit climbs.

questions.title: Will it be just the two of you, or a group?
questions.description: Determines the scale of logistics, coordination needed, and the intimacy of the experience.

questions.title: Is the hike a surprise, or does your partner know?
questions.description: Affects how plans are communicated, what gear reminders can be given, and how secretly logistics must be handled.

questions.title: What feeling do you most want your partner to take away?
questions.description: Clarifies the emotional tone — romantic and intimate, adventurous and energising, or peaceful and reflective — to shape every detail.

questions.title: What format do you want the final plan in?
questions.description: Determines whether to produce a step-by-step itinerary, a packing checklist, trail recommendations, or a full combined guide.
